Rename a workspace. Requires action__details__update on the workspace. The new name must be unique among the organization's workspaces (case-insensitive, trimmed); re-submitting the current name is accepted.

  body={{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"description":"Rename a workspace.","required":["name"],"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"description":"The new workspace name.
